standard.summary: 每步 PROGRESS_JSON 运行时特性详细度。不输出=默认(仅 loss/lr,控制台清爽);精简=压缩版(去掉逐层/基准大块);完整=全量。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: How detailed the per-step PROGRESS_JSON runtime features are. No output = the default (loss/lr only, a clean console); compact = a compressed version (the per-layer and benchmark blocks removed); full = everything.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 每步 PROGRESS_JSON 运行时特性详细度。不输出=默认(仅 loss/lr,控制台清爽);精简=压缩版(去掉逐层/基准大块);完整=全量。

advanced_en.principle: Verbosity of per-step PROGRESS_JSON runtime features. none = default (loss/lr only, keeps the console clean); compact = condensed (drops per-layer/benchmark blocks); full = everything.
